audits.title: AI crawler vs conversational agent separation
AI crawlers get the same response from the edge that browsers get
AI usage signals agree across every channel that carries them
AIPREF Content-Usage declarations are valid and can be read
Content served to AI crawlers matches the browser, or is declared
Canonical URLs point at the right page
A 402 tells a crawler how to pay
Robots directives do not block AI indexing
RSL licensing terms are discoverable and conformant
Low-value URLs excluded from AI crawls
A signed agent request is not rejected for being signed
The MCP endpoint validates Origin and its CORS policy matches its auth posture
The MCP server is listed in the official registry under a namespace this domain owns
Tool Contract Validity and Silent-Drop Risk
Shopping agents can fetch the commerce paths
Trust and evidence signals on homepage
Boilerplate tax across the crawl (unique tokens per fetch)
Ghost content: CSS-hidden text ingested as visible
Preamble tax: tokens before the first content token
Product pages carry the fields an agent-commerce feed needs
AI crawlers can reach the discovery surfaces the site advertises
Pages are covered by a discovery index
Feed entries have stable identities that resolve to their canonical pages
The origin serves and correctly 404s root-level .txt resources
Sitemap lastmod values are verifiable against the pages
The sitemap and the feed are as fresh as the site itself
Feeds advertise a WebSub hub and exactly one canonical self link
Buttons and links have accessible names
Page exposed to the accessibility tree
Form fields use valid autocomplete tokens
Content Credentials survive the image delivery pipeline
Content Credentials are signed by a certificate that can be trusted
Gesture-only controls with no discrete alternative
First-contact consent gate: cost to get past it
Form fields wired to their validation messages
Ghost-clickable elements: click targets an agent cannot address
The organization identifier resolves in the authoritative registry
Stateful controls: current state readable by an agent
AI-generated-image disclosure is machine-readable and self-consistent
trust.txt associations are reciprocated and agree with robots.txt
State-changing links an agent can trigger by fetching them
Listings walkable by URL: pagination and facet fallback
The Wikidata entity this site claims points back at this site
